digest.component_or_area: test infrastructure: source-scan and build-provenance contracts
propositions: Shipped-surface test recursively UTF-8-decodes all files under src/rebar, including ignored non-UTF-8 binaries (Mach-O esbuild), causing UnicodeDecodeError on environments with such artifacts.
Git-fallback build-provenance test fails when run on a shallow/promisor clone because it clones the source checkout and encounters unavailable historical objects.
Shipped-surface contract must enumerate only tracked/package-shipped textual inputs via git ls-files and match tokens as bytes, not arbitrary working-tree artifacts.
Build-provenance fallback test must construct a self-contained minimal Git fixture with required objects rather than depending on audit checkout completeness.
Both tests must retain behavioral oracle strength: stale command tokens and broken git-fallback must still fail.
